title: Keep browser-tab audio out of the native desktop app
problem: A persisted browser input choice makes the packaged desktop app show the web-only tab-audio banner and request Chromium microphone permission instead of opening the native microphone.
reproduce: Mark a ListenerState as native, load or submit browser for both audio devices, and observe that the pinned baseline retains those choices and exposes the browser entries in the picker.
acceptance: Native startup and settings requests normalize browser input/output to the system devices, native device lists and speaker picker omit browser choices, missing native hardware never falls back to browser capture, and non-native web deployments preserve tab audio.
repair: Pass an explicit native-app flag from Electron, migrate persisted choices at startup, enforce the boundary in runtime and HTTP paths, expose it in status, and render the native picker variant without browser entries.

verification.limitations: BCL proves native/web policy at startup helpers, HTTP settings, hardware-failure fallback and Vue rendering, then runs both complete automated suites. A packaged Electron build on the owner's microphone remains the final application check.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the packaged branch over a profile whose settings.json contains browser for input and output. Launch it, confirm the migration log appears once, the tab-audio banner and Chromium permission prompt do not appear, and native microphone speech reaches transcription. Confirm neither device picker offers THIS BROWSER TAB.

upstream.suiteOutputIncludes: PASS: native desktop audio boundary and complete suites

publish.commitMessage: fix(desktop): keep browser audio out of the native app
